📅 Quality Check Planner

The Planner helps you organize your assigned Quality Checks, identify upcoming deadlines, and distribute planned appointments across the available calendar weeks.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📊 YOUR QUALITY CHECK OVERVIEW

At the top of the Planner, you will find a pie chart showing all Quality Checks assigned to you, grouped by their current status.

Use this overview to quickly identify:

  • Total assigned Quality Checks
  • Scheduled Quality Checks
  • Unscheduled Quality Checks
  • Quality Checks already in progress or completed

💡 Tip: Check this overview regularly to identify open Quality Checks that still require planning.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📅 PLANNED QUALITY CHECKS BY CALENDAR WEEK

Next to the pie chart, you will find a bar chart showing all Quality Checks that have already been scheduled but have not yet been completed.

The checks are grouped by calendar week.

Use this chart to:

  • Review your upcoming workload
  • Identify heavily planned calendar weeks
  • Find available capacity for additional appointments
  • Distribute your Quality Checks more evenly

✅ Recommendation: Review the weekly distribution before scheduling additional Quality Checks.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📋 UNSCHEDULED QUALITY CHECKS

At the bottom of the Planner, you will find all Quality Checks assigned to you that have not yet been scheduled.

The table can be sorted to help you prioritize your planning.

📆 Important Dates

Start Date

The earliest date from which the Quality Check can be carried out at the customer.

Due Date

The latest date by which the Quality Check must be completed at the customer.

✅ The planned appointment should therefore be scheduled between the Start Date and the Due Date.

💡 Planning Recommendation:

Prioritize Quality Checks by Due Date – earliest first. This ensures that checks with the closest deadline are considered first.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🔎 SHOWING MORE QUALITY CHECKS

The table in the Planner displays a maximum of 30 Quality Checks.

If additional unscheduled Quality Checks exist, click the table overview to open the corresponding List View.

The List View provides access to additional records and loads more Quality Checks as you scroll.

💡 Use the List View if you cannot find a specific Quality Check in the Planner or if you want to use additional sorting and filtering options.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

➡️ OPEN A QUALITY CHECK

To open a Quality Check for planning, simply click the Quality Check Name in the table.

Example:

👉 QC-2026-00001

This opens the corresponding Quality Check record where you can continue with the final scheduling.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📍 BEFORE SCHEDULING

Before selecting an appointment, check:

✅ Is the appointment between Start Date and Due Date?

✅ How many Quality Checks are already planned for the respective calendar week?

✅ Can the Quality Check be combined efficiently with existing customer visits or route planning?

Once the Quality Check has been scheduled, it will no longer appear in the unscheduled list and will be reflected in the weekly planning overview.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

✅ RECOMMENDED PLANNING PROCESS

1. Review the pie chart to understand your overall Quality Check status.

2. Review the bar chart to see your planned workload by calendar week.

3. Check the Due Dates of your unscheduled Quality Checks.

4. Prioritize Quality Checks with the earliest Due Dates.

5. Click the Quality Check Name to open the record.

6. Schedule the Quality Check between its Start Date and Due Date.

7. Return to the Planner and review your updated weekly workload.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

💡 GENERAL GUIDANCE

  • Schedule Quality Checks as early as possible.
  • Always consider the period between Start Date and Due Date.
  • Prioritize Quality Checks with upcoming Due Dates.
  • Aim for a balanced distribution across calendar weeks.
  • Consider existing customer visits and route planning.
  • Use the List View if more than 30 unscheduled Quality Checks are available.
  • Use the Planner as your central overview for managing your personal Quality Check schedule.
